intro: Badges are little icons you hand out. The built-in Verified badge is always here. Upload your own, then give them to people from Accounts → Manage → Badges, or to yourself with the button below.
show_next_to_name_hint: Show next to the name everywhere (otherwise only on their profile)
image_note: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 256 KB and 128×128.
verified_note: Built in. Always shown next to the name.
delete_message: It disappears from everyone who has it.
